android.desc:
Browse with infinite extensions. Now with AI. Mask Browser makes it ease to browse the web, discover the news, watch videos, check emails and listen to music. 

With the support for both Google extensions and Edge add-ons, you can unlock desktop browsing experience. Chrome extensions like Tampermonkey, Violentmonkey, Adguard, Adblocker, Ghostery, LastPass, Dark Reader will facilitate your exploration of the online world. Mask Browser also integrates a free AI chat companion powered by ChatGPT-4o. Free to elevate your work, life and study with creative AI interactions. 

Key Features：
✨Extensive Browser Extensions: Support a plethora of extensions from Chrome Web Store and Microsoft Edge. Grammarly, Bitwarden, Save to Pocket, Global Speed, StayFocusd, are simply accessible in one Extension Store, taking your browser translation, password management and ad blocking to the next level!

✨One-stop Extension Management: Easily toggle the bottom toolbar to enable and disable the Chrome extensions or Edge plugins at any time. At the extension management page, you are able to update all extensions with a simple click. 

✨Local extensions import: Import crx, zip, or user.js files to customize your browser to work just the way you like it. Have fun with more options than just Chrome extensions!

✨Personal AI Assistant: Experience productivity like never before with our AI chat assistant, driven by ChatGPT-4o, to help handle questions, summarize texts, generate ideas, check grammar, plan careers, compose poems, translate, and write code.

✨Free ChatGPT AI Chatbot: Get instant answers from ChatGPT-4o AI chat. Alongside the free human-like chat withChatGPT-4o，Claude，Gemini AI , you can also chat with ERNIE AI chat, and Qianfan-bloomz chat AI. Ask AI anything about any topic for FREE! 

✨Incognito Browsing: Enter incognito mode with an easy click for enhanced privacy and security. 

✨Versatile Search Engine Options: Effortless navigation between popular search engines such as Google Search, Bing Search, Yandex Search, DuckDuckGo Search, Yahoo Search, Ecosia Search, Baidu Search, Sogou Search, etc. (The search engines are recommended based on your country and region)

✨Convenient Homepage: Customizable homepage for quick access to popular websites like Facebook, YouTube, Amazon, Wikipedia, Ebay, Instagram, Discord, ESPN and more. Also get the popular extensions at a glance in our homepage. 

✨One-click Translation Tool: Effectively translate webpages
